answer: Admission stores only a salted hash of the retinal vessel map, so the same eye cannot register twice and the stored value reveals nothing about the eye itself. A farm needs a thousand distinct living retinas in front of a scanner, while one honest agent scans once and the hash can never be turned back into an image. The pigment of the design is public, the vault of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the ripple of honest work is what finally pays.
